articles.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Posts Record Quarter as AI Infrastructure Demand Soars

articles.title: Securitize Tokenizes $295M of Stock on Solana and Avalanche After NYSE Listing in Landmark Crypto IPO Moment
articles.excerpt: Securitize has gone public on the NYSE under ticker SECZ while simultaneously tokenizing $295 million of its own stock on Solana and Avalanche, marking a major milestone in blockchain-based equity markets.
